smtp_port.description: TCP port on which the mailfromd SMTP listener accepts connections.

smtp_bindto.description: IP address or hostname to bind the SMTP listener to (empty = all interfaces).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous SMTP connections allowed.

connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for client to complete the connection handshake.

mail_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the MAIL FROM command after connection.

data_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the DATA command and message body transmission.

command_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for each SMTP command (after initial connection).

max_message_size.description: Maximum message size in bytes (0 = unlimited).

max_recipients.description: Maximum number of recipients allowed per message.

run_user.description: System user to run the daemon as (must exist).

run_group.description: System group to run the daemon as (must exist).

chroot.description: Chroot directory (empty = disabled). For security hardening.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for incoming SMTP connections (STARTTLS).

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format).

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format).

spf_enabled.description: Enable SPF (Sender Policy Framework) header verification.

greylisting_enabled.description: Enable greylisting to temporarily reject unknown senders on first attempt.

greylisting_dir.description: Directory to store greylisting state files.

greylisting_delay.description: Seconds to wait before re-accepting a greylisted sender (first retry).

dnsbl_lists.description: List of DNS-based blackhole lists (RBLs) to query for sender IP reputation.

items.description: Domain name of a DNSBL (e.g., zen.spamhaus.org).

relay_host.description: Optional upstream MTA relay host (e.g., smtp.example.com:587). If empty, mail is delivered directly.

sasl_enabled.description: Enable SMTP authentication (SASL) for authorized relay clients.

rate_limiting_enabled.description: Enable per-IP rate limiting to curb abuse.

rate_limit_per_ip.description: Maximum number of connections or messages per IP in the rate window.

extra_directives.description: Additional raw mailfromd configuration directives (e.g., macro definitions, custom ACL rules). Each item is one full line.

items.description: A single line of mailfromd config directive (must be valid syntax).
